findings.scope: Native wood volume, white spike readability, shared project family
findings.actual: All 4 Forest windows retain dark quiet fill/broken green moss rim and same courier as 2 actual Plains controls. Thorn bodies now have woody light/shadow clusters, thick tapered forks and individually readable pale tips; they are materially more visible and embodied than the previous mathematical lines. Short mouth underside and side sprites read as attached woody branches rather than independent hazard bricks.
findings.limit: This accepts those static improvements only, not natural winding of the complete long run or collision fairness.

findings.actual: A roughly 76.8 screen-pixel module recurs across long upper/lower runs. Despite A/B order differences, similarly sized forks, evenly substantial stems and repeated upward/downward antler silhouettes dominate. Continuous brown edge reads as a mounted antler fence more than a naturally winding briar stem.
findings.expected: A continuous main vine has changing local ascent, fork lengths and quiet intervals, with subordinate growth instead of every module contributing a comparable antler.
findings.bounded_fix: One bounded native-family revision of existing A/B cells: change dominant fork silhouette and offset the main stem through the cells so existing ports still join but visual growth is not equal-height/equal-weight. Keep pale dangerous tips readable within current authored depth and hazard envelope; no RNG jitter, opacity rescue, math-line reboot, new tile material family or geometry change.

findings.type: Independent AI visual judgment backed by renderer inspection
findings.screen_region: upper x747..777 y335..392; especially lower x596..758 y535..657
findings.actual: Native sprites improve the texture and thickness of the turn, but the lower bare link still draws a long near-vertical wooden post, then an almost horizontal bottom rail. Small rounded end stamps do not overcome this right-angle bracket/scaffold silhouette.
findings.expected: A branch bends around the actual step as growth with a changing silhouette, keeping this connecting portion blunt and confined to real terrain.
findings.bounded_fix: Replace only the bare stepped-connection outline with an authored native bent elbow/return and short tapering join suited to this real step. Avoid a long straight post and straight bottom rail. Keep clipping to the existing solid union and do not add pale tips, false standing ledges, damage or physics.
